# Jamie Kerig

> Jamie Kerig is a front-end web developer and graphic designer based in Maryland (Towson University design graduate, 9+ years building web pages and e-mails at Marketwise). This is the portfolio site, with web and graphic design work, writing, and local web design pages for Harford County, Maryland.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://jamiekerig.com/): overview of Jamie Kerig's web and graphic design work.
- [About](https://jamiekerig.com/about/): background, education and experience.
- [Web design work](https://jamiekerig.com/web/): websites, landing pages and e-mail designs, with samples.
- [Graphic design work](https://jamiekerig.com/graphic/): logos, branding and print pieces.
- [Contact](https://jamiekerig.com/contact/): contact form for web or design projects.
- [Articles](https://jamiekerig.com/articles/): writing on design and the web.
